messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] hbInstall("aroma.tcga")
parts:
Hi,

thanks for this report.

The aroma.tcga package is under heavy development due to lots of
recent development by the TCGA Data Collection Center.

At the moment, because of this, I'd say there is no good reason for
you to try to use aroma.tcga. I also do not have any documentation
available for it, so you would be pretty much left to the source code,
if you use it.

I've updated http://aroma-project.org/install to reflect this.

If you have particular needs for using aroma.tcga, let me know.

/Henrik
